semantics.ownership: A projection belongs to its containing form. Only the event envelope carries session, turn, iteration and form_index. Activity is not a View and never enters model context.
semantics.delivery: Each block.activity is a complete replacement, not a delta. Envelope seq orders revisions. Reconnect replays the latest replacement; settled evidence is durable.
semantics.lifecycle: The engine allocates invocation identity and entry sequence, records running before execution, and exactly one succeeded, failed or cancelled result. Presentation cannot control the operation.
semantics.counts: Counts describe observed invocations, including omitted rows. Group rows are presentation, not additional invocations. omitted.by_classification counts omitted evidence by signal.
semantics.bounds: Redact credential-bearing structured fields before summarizing; enforce UTF-8 byte limits. Row ids are globally unique within a projection. At most max_rows top-level rows and max_depth child edges. Omission is explicit, never invented success.
semantics.declaration: Symbols may select a presenter and label and publish bounded content replacements during their invocation. Content includes headings, Markdown, tables, code, diffs, attachment references and progress. The engine alone owns invocation identity, timing and outcome; content cannot author lifecycle events. Presentation failures never alter tool results.
